facts.evidence: Consolidated revenues increased 24% to $119.8 billion, with 23% growth in constant currency.
Google Cloud revenues surged 82% to $24.8 billion, fueled by demand for AI infrastructure and solutions.
Google Services revenues grew 15% to $94.5 billion, driven by 17% growth in Google Search & other and 15% in subscriptions, platforms, and devices.

Monitor the impact of the $98.0 billion net gain from equity securities on future financial performance.

claims.claim: Consolidated revenues increased 24% to $119.8 billion.
Revenue growth was 23% in constant currency.
Google Services revenues grew 15% to $94.5 billion.
Google Services growth was driven by 17% growth in Google Search & other.
Google Services growth was driven by 15% growth in subscriptions, platforms, and devices.
Google Cloud revenues surged 82% to $24.8 billion.
Google Cloud growth was fueled by demand for AI infrastructure and solutions.
Operating income rose 30%.
Operating income was $40.8 billion.
Operating margin was 34%.
Google Search & other revenues increased 17% to $63.3 billion.
Google Search & other revenue growth reflected strong performance in AI features and search query growth.
claims.note: The release's CEO quote says AI features are driving Search query growth; it does not attribute the 17% Search revenue increase to AI features or query growth.

claims.claim: YouTube ads revenues grew 13% to $11.1 billion.
YouTube ads revenue growth was supported by high viewership during major events like the FIFA World Cup 2026.
claims.note: The release cites 1.7 billion unique viewers of World Cup-related videos as an engagement point but never links it to YouTube ads revenue growth.

claims.claim: Google Cloud revenues expanded 82% to $24.8 billion, driven by enterprise AI solutions and infrastructure.
No specific guidance was provided for future periods.
Alphabet issued $49.6 billion in equity to scale AI infrastructure and global compute.
Alphabet entered into an ATM Program to sell up to $40.0 billion of Class A and Class C stock, with proceeds intended for tax obligations.
Alphabet issued senior unsecured notes for $20.3 billion to fund general corporate purposes.
There was a $98.0 billion net gain from equity securities.
claims.note: Contradicts the release: $98.0 billion (97,983) is other income (expense), net; the gain on equity securities, net was $99.0 billion (99,031). The release also discloses a $6.26 diluted EPS effect from that gain, which the brief omits.

claims.claim: Google Cloud revenue growth in the quarter was 82%.
Alphabet completed a $49.6 billion equity raise and has an ATM Program.
